figures.title: Financial workflow and attack entry points
figures.title_zh: 金融身份工作流与攻击入口
figures.description: The identity relationship is established before an action is authorized. Follow reference enrollment, fresh capture, media evidence, identity matching, decision policy and recovery through one financial workflow.

figures.title: Composition of the selected literature
figures.title_zh: 文献选集的主题与发表分布
figures.description: Topic and year distributions describe the selected 141 research records. The radial chart is a count profile of this collection, not a ranking of methods or a census of the field.

figures.title: A taxonomy of face fraud across trust boundaries
figures.title_zh: 跨越信任边界的人脸欺诈分类
figures.description: Attack entry and media production are separate axes. Printed portraits, replay, masks and digitally manipulated media can cross different trust boundaries.

figures.title: Detection evidence and its prerequisites
figures.description: Eight families of detection evidence are shown alongside their prerequisites. The image examples are synthetic illustrations rather than measured feature maps or detector predictions.

figures.title: Morphing and the integrity of identity references
figures.title_zh: 人脸融合与身份参考的完整性
figures.description: Morphing can contaminate identity references before issuance. A legitimately signed document can preserve the provenance of a reference without establishing that the reference represents one true identity.

figures.title: Benchmark units, modalities and reported composition
figures.title_zh: 基准的计数单位、模态与组成
figures.description: Sample composition is grouped by original counting unit, alongside a modality matrix. Stream, image, recording and sequence counts retain their original-paper definitions and missing class counts.

figures.title: Five axes of separation in evaluation
figures.title_zh: 评估中需要隔离的五类因素
figures.description: Evaluation separates identity, original source, generator, device or channel, and time. Threshold selection and target-domain permissions remain explicit design choices.

figures.title: Base rates, operating points and review burden
figures.title_zh: 基率、工作点与复核负担
figures.description: Analytical curves connect prevalence and operating points to alert precision and review burden. Confidence and repeated-attempt analyses retain their stated sampling assumptions.

figures.title: Binding facial evidence to a protected action
figures.title_zh: 将人脸证据绑定到受保护的业务动作
figures.description: Capture, liveness, matching and a protected action need evidence from the same event. The architecture illustrates binding and review controls, without claiming a certified implementation.

figures.title: Research priorities across the evidence chain
figures.description: Research opportunities connect detector robustness to references, provenance, authorization and accessible recovery. The agenda is a conceptual synthesis, not a numerical priority ranking.
